title: Clock not vertically centered when using a time format without a leading zero for hours
line: With a one-digit hour, the clock's time and time zone no longer leave an extra gap and stay centered over the date.
explanation: In a horizontal panel with the date shown, the time zone label sits on the same row as the time. The time label was always as wide as the widest possible time (two hour digits) with its text centered inside, so a one-digit hour left blank space before the time zone and pushed the row off center over the date. The time label is now sized to its own text in that layout, while the applet width is still computed from the widest time, so the clock doesn't change width when the hour does.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: keep time and zone centered for one-digit hours

The time label was as wide as the widest time with its text centered, so
with the zone next to it a one-digit hour left a gap and the row sat off
center over the date; size it to its text there, keeping applet width.

BUG: 434598

patches.diff:
From 87dcdf6b99920c34bcf672b80c8b5ff021254c06 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:56:48 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/digital-clock: keep time and zone centered for
 one-digit hours

The time label was as wide as the widest time with its text centered, so
with the zone next to it a one-digit hour left a gap and the row sat off
center over the date; size it to its text there, keeping applet width.

BUG: 434598
---
 applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
index 8c918109d0..47156bbba3 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
@@ -151,13 +151,13 @@ MouseArea {
                 main.Layout.maximumWidth: main.Layout.minimumWidth
 
                 contentItem.height: timeLabel.height + (contentItem.Plasmoid.configuration.showDate || timeZoneLabel.visible ? 0.8 * timeLabel.height : 0)
-                contentItem.width: Math.max(timeLabel.width + (contentItem.Plasmoid.configuration.showDate ? timeZoneLabel.paintedWidth : 0),
+                contentItem.width: Math.max(sizehelper.contentWidth + (contentItem.Plasmoid.configuration.showDate ? timeZoneLabel.paintedWidth : 0),
                                 timeZoneLabel.paintedWidth, dateLabel.paintedWidth) + Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
 
                 labelsGrid.rows: labelsGrid.Plasmoid.configuration.showDate ? 1 : 2
 
                 timeLabel.height: sizehelper.height
-                timeLabel.width: sizehelper.contentWidth
+                timeLabel.width: timeLabel.Plasmoid.configuration.showDate ? timeLabel.implicitWidth : sizehelper.contentWidth
                 timeLabel.font.pixelSize: timeLabel.height
 
                 timeZoneLabel.height: timeZoneLabel.Plasmoid.configuration.showDate ? 0.7 * timeLabel.height : 0.8 * timeLabel.height
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master, en_US 12h, time zone shown: 7:56 AM (top) has a wide gap before (-08) and sits off center; 11:56 PM (bottom) for reference
With the fix: 7:57 AM has the same gap before (-08) as 11:57 PM and is centered over the date; applet width unchanged

review.text: Sizing `timeLabel.width` to `timeLabel.implicitWidth` when `showDate` is active in the `horizontalPanel` state while keeping `contentItem.width` based on `sizehelper.contentWidth` cleanly fixes the extra gap and horizontal misalignment for one-digit hours without causing the applet width to jump. It introduces no binding loops, leaves other panel states and non-date layouts untouched, and the zoomed before/after screenshots clearly verify both centering and stable width.

reviews.text: Sizing `timeLabel.width` to `timeLabel.implicitWidth` when `showDate` is active in the `horizontalPanel` state while keeping `contentItem.width` based on `sizehelper.contentWidth` cleanly fixes the extra gap and horizontal misalignment for one-digit hours without causing the applet width to jump. It introduces no binding loops, leaves other panel states and non-date layouts untouched, and the zoomed before/after screenshots clearly verify both centering and stable width.

This matches the reporter's c2/c3 clarification (row off-center and a bigger gap before the zone), not a width change. It also respects Nate's c1 point: the applet width still comes from sizehelper, so the clock doesn't resize when the hour changes. The fix is small and in the right place, the time label takes its own width only when date and zone share a row with it, and the screenshots show an even gap and the row centered. The commit body is one run-on sentence and could be easier to read, but the code is ready.
